753:t_157:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Are you trying to tell me you'll make my wish come true?」

753:t_157:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Precisely. If you wish it, I will arrange for you to be reunited with your loved ones in the new world.」

753:t_157:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, Mr. Wannabe God! I'm not that patient!」

753:t_157:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So I'll protect the present with my own hands! The world we live in now, the one that leads to the future!!」

753:t_157:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「$$ロックオン・ストラトス$$! Even if my target's a god, I'll snipe it!!」

753:t_158:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アレルヤ$$... and $$ハレルヤ$$, $$ピーリス$$, $$マリー$$... I will save your wounded souls.」

753:t_158:1.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「This man...! Does he intend to win us over!」

753:t_158:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is not so. With great love, I will bring your battles to an end.」

753:t_158:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In the new world, you will become new lives and grasp new happiness.」

753:t_158:5.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(Don't let him talk you around, $$アレルヤ$$! Basically, he's saying he's going to kill us!)

753:t_158:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Death is merely a rite of passage. I will carry your souls, stripped of flesh, to the new world.」

753:t_158:7.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(So he's going to kill us after all! That's the kind of guy he is!)

753:t_158:8.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You're right, $$ハレルヤ$$! He's the kind of man who takes people's lives with a smile!」

753:t_158:9.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「We can't hand our lives or our future over to a man like that! Let's go, $$アレルヤ$$!」

753:t_158:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$$アレルヤ・ハプティズム$$! I'll end every battle right here!!」

753:t_159:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ティエリア$$... Your mission as one born an $$イノベイド$$ is over. Rest in peace.」

753:t_159:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't decide that for me! My mission is to watch over humanity's destination... in other words, $$刹那$$'s fight!」

753:t_159:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And to fight those who stand in its way!」

753:t_159:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rest assured. I will decide humanity's future.」

753:t_159:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I have no intention of listening to the words of someone who approves of the universe's collapse!」

753:t_159:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ティエリア・アーデ$$! I'll strike down those who block humanity's future, right here!!」

753:t_159:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is my mission as an $$イノベイド$$, and the reason $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ exists!!」

753:t_160:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$グラハム$$... Do you intend to recklessly throw away lives that were saved?」

753:t_160:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I won't have anyone else decide how I use my life!」

753:t_160:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「My life is for humanity's future...! In other words, I'll use it to defeat you!」

753:t_160:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This world's humanity has no future. I already told you as much.」

753:t_160:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your fight is futile, $$グラハム$$!」

753:t_160:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Evil god! Don't call my name so casually!」

753:t_160:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「My comrades will advance along the path I cut open! I'll teach you that even this small life is not in vain!!」

753:t_161:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you reject me too, $$パトリック$$?」

753:t_161:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Acting like a god, what a joke! The only one who gets to call me by that name is the Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General!」

753:t_161:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「If you're going to call me something, make it Immortal $$コーラサワー$$ or Happy $$コーラサワー$$!」

753:t_161:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I shall do as you say.」

753:t_161:4.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You fell for it, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_161:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You admitted I'm immortal and lucky! Which means you can't win!」

753:t_161:7.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll do it, Colonel! I'll take this guy down fast, go back to Earth, and have you praise me!!」

753:t_162:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your battle, colored by sorrow, ends today. $$シン$$... you are free now.」

753:t_162:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Be glad. All battles will soon be over. And the universe will be reborn.」

753:t_162:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「No, I will not be silent. Admit it, $$シン$$.」

753:t_162:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your battle will soon be over, when everything returns to nothingness.」

753:t_162:7.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm the one who decides when my battle ends! And I can already see where it ends!」

753:t_162:8.en:
$$シン$$
「It's beating you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and saving the universe!」

753:t_162:10.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm not going to listen to a word you say! I'll overcome war... I'll overcome an existence like you!!」

753:t_163:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your days full of regret end too, $$キラ$$. Sorrow and suffering will vanish along with this world.」

753:t_163:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「That means the lives living in this world will be lost...」

753:t_163:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Those lives will be reincarnated in the new world. There is nothing to fear.」

753:t_163:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「You can say that because... you've had eternal life yourself...」

753:t_163:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「You don't understand the meaning of life! That's why you can do something like that!」

753:t_163:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is what a god is. An absolute being you cannot surpass.」

753:t_163:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I deny you! By surpassing that existence!」

753:t_163:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have my feelings and my strength...! They give me limitless power!!」

753:t_164:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「A lone soldier defeats a god and saves the universe. Not a bad ending.」

753:t_164:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're quite the romantic for a soldier, $$ナイジェル$$.」

753:t_164:2.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Sorry. I consider myself a realist.」

753:t_164:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I carry out what I say...! Brace yourself, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_165:0.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「I never thought I'd end up fighting a self-proclaimed god to stop the universe's collapse.」

753:t_165:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am going to become a true god, $$コンロイ$$.」

753:t_165:2.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「I don't trust people who get too familiar. And in that respect, your shadiness is in a class of its own.」

753:t_165:3.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$エコーズ$$ doesn't choose its battlefields or its enemies! If someone appears who takes away the citizens' peace and freedom, we simply fight to eliminate them!」

753:t_166:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$シャア$$... You were a man with the power to move humanity toward the future, beyond even being a $$ニュータイプ$$.」

753:t_166:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Hearing words like that, I am all the more unable to let either myself or the world end here...!」

753:t_166:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you intend to stop the universe's collapse and take on the role of humanity's guide?」

753:t_166:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「I don't know what lies ahead... But if I don't stop you here, humanity has no future...!」

753:t_166:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I swore to stake my life on that! To $$ララァ$$... to $$フロンタル$$!」

753:t_166:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Bound by the dead...! You cling to the past, $$赤い彗星$$!」

753:t_166:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it! I fight only for the future they wished for!」

753:t_166:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$, you who block humanity's future! We will go on, beyond you!!」

753:t_167:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rest now, $$マリーダ$$. You no longer need to fight.」

753:t_167:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Coming from an enemy like you, that's not persuasive at all...!」

753:t_167:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am not your enemy. I am the one who saves everything.」

753:t_167:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Are those the words of a man who merely watches the universe collapse out of the corner of his eye!」

753:t_167:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I have no intention of accepting an existence like you! I will fight those who steal the future... the light!」

753:t_168:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$クェス$$... I will fill your loneliness.」
